rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for an emotional rather than rational person, mood, work, or response, especially without a strongly negative tone.

example.english: This film is very sentimental and makes my eyes well up.
example.traditional: 呢套電影好感性，睇到我眼濕濕。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 din6 jing2 hou2 gam2 sing3 tai2 dou2 ngo5 ngaan5 sap1 sap1

rows.note: Use this for someone or something excessively tender, emotionally delicate, or prone to melancholy rather than merely emotion-based.

example.english: They have always been sentimental; even an old song makes them think of many past events.
example.traditional: 佢一向多愁善感，聽到一首舊歌都會諗起好多往事。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 do1 sau4 sin6 gam2 teng1 dou3 jat1 sau2 gau6 go1 dou1 wui5 nam2 hei2 hou2 do1 wong5 si6

rows.note: Use this when emotions are influencing a decision or action instead of logical reasoning.

example.english: Don't be sentimental; calm down and think it through before deciding.
example.traditional: 你唔好感情用事，先冷靜諗清楚再決定。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 cing4 jung6 si6 sin1 laang5 zing6 nam2 cing1 co2 zoi3 kyut3 ding6
